# Load Libraries

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(knitr)
library(fixest)       
library(broom)
library(broom.mixed)
library(scales)
```

# Load Data

```{r}
datafile = "upworthy_archive_data.csv"

data = read_csv(datafile, show_col_types = FALSE)

kable(head(data), digits = 2, format = "markdown")
```

# Prepare Data

## Exclusions

```{r}
# remove A/B tests where no headline variant recieved any clicks and remove tests that have only one headline variant
n_raw = nrow(data)
t_raw = n_distinct(data$clickability_test_id)

data = data %>%
  group_by(clickability_test_id) %>%
  filter(sum(clicks, na.rm = TRUE) > 0, n() > 1) %>%
  ungroup()

cat("Dropped", n_raw - nrow(data), "of", n_raw, "variants and",
    t_raw - n_distinct(data$clickability_test_id), "of", t_raw, "tests\n")
```

## Data Types and Levels

```{r}
# ensure data types are correct and set levels
data = data %>%
  mutate(
    # factor the A/B test set ID variable
    clickability_test_id = factor(clickability_test_id),
    # factor the villain and victim predictions
    villain_pred = factor(villain_pred, levels = c(0, 1)),
    victim_pred  = factor(victim_pred,  levels = c(0, 1))
  )

# create the moral agent variable
data = data %>%
  mutate(
    moral_agent = factor(
      case_when(
        villain_pred == 1 & victim_pred == 1 ~ "dyad",
        villain_pred == 1 & victim_pred == 0 ~ "villain_only",
        villain_pred == 0 & victim_pred == 1 ~ "victim_only",
        TRUE                                 ~ "neither"
      ),
      levels = c("neither", "dyad", "villain_only", "victim_only")
    )
  )
```

# Descriptives

```{r}
agent_props = data %>%
  count(moral_agent) %>%
  mutate(proportion = n / sum(n))

kable(agent_props, digits = 2)
```

```{r}
variation_summary = data %>%
  group_by(clickability_test_id) %>%
  summarise(
    agent_mixed = n_distinct(moral_agent) > 1,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    n_tests            = n(),
    n_agent_mixed      = sum(agent_mixed)
  )

kable(variation_summary, digits = 2)
```

# **Dyadic moral framing increases engagement**

```{r}
m_agent = fepois(
  clicks ~
    moral_agent | clickability_test_id,
  offset = ~ log(impressions),
  data   = data,
  vcov   = "cluster"
)
```

```{r}
broom::tidy(
  m_agent,
  conf.int = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(across(c(estimate, conf.low, conf.high), exp)) %>%
  kable(digits = 4)
```

```{r}
# pairwise irr contrasts
b = coef(m_agent)
V = vcov(m_agent)

terms = c(Neither = NA, Dyad = "moral_agentdyad",
          `Villain only` = "moral_agentvillain_only",
          `Victim only`  = "moral_agentvictim_only")

pairs_list = combn(names(terms), 2, simplify = FALSE)

fe_contrasts = map_dfr(pairs_list, function(p) {
  cv = setNames(rep(0, length(b)), names(b))
  if (!is.na(terms[p[1]])) cv[terms[p[1]]] = 1
  if (!is.na(terms[p[2]])) cv[terms[p[2]]] = -1
  est = sum(cv * b)
  se  = sqrt(t(cv) %*% V %*% cv)[1, 1]
  tibble(contrast = paste(p[1], "/", p[2]),
         ratio = exp(est),
         conf.low = exp(est - 1.96 * se),
         conf.high = exp(est + 1.96 * se),
         z = est / se,
         p.value = 2 * pnorm(-abs(est / se)))
})

kable(fe_contrasts, digits = 2)
```

# Figure 5

```{r}
custom_colors = c(
  "Neither"      = "#EDEEC9",
  "Villain only" = "#B20D30",
  "Victim only"  = "#00B4D8",
  "Dyad"         = "#DF57BC"
)

agent_irr = broom::tidy(m_agent, conf.int = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(across(c(estimate, conf.low, conf.high), exp))

agent_irr_plot = agent_irr %>%
  mutate(term = recode(term,
                       "moral_agentdyad"         = "Dyad",
                       "moral_agentvillain_only" = "Villain only",
                       "moral_agentvictim_only"  = "Victim only")) %>%
  ggplot(aes(estimate, term, color = term)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = 2) +
  geom_point(size = 4) +
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = conf.low, xmax = conf.high), height = .12, width = 0.1, linewidth = 2) +
  labs(x = "Incidence Rate Ratio", y = NULL) +
  scale_color_manual(values = custom_colors) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    axis.title = element_text(size = 18),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 16),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", color = NA),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", color = NA)
    )

ggsave(
  filename = "agent_model_contrasts_plot.png",
  plot = agent_irr_plot,
  width = 6, height = 4,
  bg = "transparent")

ggsave(
  filename = "agent_model_contrasts_plot.svg",
  plot = agent_irr_plot,
  width = 6, height = 4,
  bg = "transparent")

agent_irr_plot
```
